issues.title: feat: gates that need a lock and a retry
issues.body:
The e2e suite binds a fixed port and the unit suite trips over a random UUID.

## 対象ファイル
- `src/gates.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] it works

```acceptance-gates
version: 1
gates:
  - id: issue-370-e2e
    command: "npm run test:e2e"
    timeoutSec: 1800
    mutex: e2e-port
  - id: issue-370-unit
    command: "npm run test:unit"
    retryOnFail: 1
    flakyIsPass: true
  - id: issue-370-explicit-default
    command: "npm run lint"
    retryOnFail: 0
    flakyIsPass: false
```
